listingDraft.shortDescriptionEs: Gestiona tu empresa y tus ubicaciones desde un solo lugar.
listingDraft.shortDescriptionEn: Manage your organisation and locations in one place.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEs: AkiHQ es el centro de gestión de AkiSuite para empresas. Organiza tu empresa, establecimientos, alojamientos y flotas desde un mismo espacio. Gestiona fichas y permisos de equipo según tus accesos. Las funciones disponibles dependen del tipo de negocio y del estado de tu cuenta.
listingDraft.fullDescriptionEn: AkiHQ is the AkiSuite management hub for businesses. Organise your company, venues, accommodation and rental branches from one workspace. Manage listings and team access where authorised. Available tools depend on your business type and account permissions.

sourceObservation: Production akihq.app is Cloudflare Worker akihq-management-preview; elguiriashing/AkiBusiness is the historical Next.js management repo with build-time role swap. Confirm exact deployed Worker commit before native packaging.

delivery.android: Android App Bundle (.aab) signed for Play App Signing, not generated
delivery.ios: Signed .ipa archive and TestFlight build, not generated

notes: Do not insert app signing keys, provisioning profiles, personal details, reviewer passwords or store API keys in Git.
Do not publish android/.well-known/assetlinks.json or apple-app-site-association with guessed fingerprints/team IDs.
Respect AkiSuite cross-domain OAuth callback and application deep linking; each product must survive login, logout and password recovery.
No automatic purchase-flow enabling: review mobile digital subscription rules and local availability before release.
